Author: Manoj Kumar Gupta

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.

2. The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to respondent No.2 i.e. District Magistrate, Varanasi to decide the objection of the petitioner dated 22.03.2024 wherein the petitioners have prayed for award of compensation to them as per provisions of the new Act i.e the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
Hari Shankar And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142970627/

entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Hari Shankar And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. It appears that some part of land of the petitioners is proposed to be taken over by the respondents on basis of mutual consent for expanding the runway of Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport, District Varanasi.
4. The case of the petitioners is that the amount being offered to them is not adequate and they are claiming compensation as per the provisions of the Act.

5. Since the acquisition is on basis of mutual consent and, therefore, in case, the offer of the respondents is not acceptable to the petitioners, it is open to them not to accept the same but this Court in exercise of writ jurisdiction cannot compel the respondents to enhance compensation nor any forum is prescribed for determining the right amount of compensation in such cases.
6.
Subject to the aforesaid observations, the petition is disposed of.

Order Date :- 16.5.2024 AKShukla/-
(Kshitij Shailendra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.)
